headword: {相談|そうだん}{窓口|まどぐち}

definitions.gloss: consultation counter; inquiry desk; help desk
definitions.explanation: A service counter or contact point where people can seek advice, ask questions, or get help with procedures. Found at government offices, hospitals, banks, and other institutions.

examples.japanese: {相談|そうだん}{窓口|まどぐち}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: To go to the consultation counter.

examples.japanese: ⟦{市|し}{役所|やくしょ}→市役所：03067_shiyakusho⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{相談|そうだん}{窓口|まどぐち}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{手続|てつづ}き→手続き：05453_tetsuzuki⟧⟦について→〜について：03103_nitsuite⟧⟦{聞|き}いた→聞く：00483_kiku⟧。
examples.english: I asked about the procedures at the city hall consultation counter.

examples.japanese: ⟦{消費者|しょうひしゃ}→消費者：09866_shouhisha⟧{相談|そうだん}{窓口|まどぐち}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{苦情|くじょう}→苦情：00252_kujou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{申|もう}し{出|で}た→申し出る：10465_moushideru⟧。
examples.english: I filed a complaint at the consumer consultation counter.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{相談|そうだん}→相談：02089_soudan⟧ (consultation) and ⟦{窓口|まどぐち}→窓口：03154_madoguchi⟧ (counter/window). This is a frequently encountered term in Japanese bureaucratic and institutional contexts. Many government offices, hospitals, and companies have dedicated consultation counters for specific topics.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {相談|そうだん}{窓口|まどぐち}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{問|と}い{合|あ}わせる→問い合わせる：17737_toiawaseru⟧: to inquire at the consultation counter
- {相談|そうだん}{窓口|まどぐち}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{設|もう}ける→設ける：14220_moukeru⟧: to set up a consultation counter
- ⟦{無料|むりょう}→無料：01662_muryou⟧{相談|そうだん}{窓口|まどぐち}: free consultation counter
- ⟦{電話|でんわ}→電話：01471_denwa⟧{相談|そうだん}{窓口|まどぐち}: telephone consultation line
